<h1>You are a vampire bat.</h1>
<p class="g-lede">You are a young bat, still learning to hunt, and you feed on the blood of
sleeping cattle. <strong>Three nights without a meal will kill you</strong> — and you strike
out far more often than the adults roosting around you. When your luck fails, only your
friends can save you: vampire bats share blood with the partners who have groomed and fed
them before. Fifteen nights stand between you and the wet season. The last of them are
storms. Build the bonds that will carry you through.</p>
<div class="g-cta">

</table></div>

<details class="wyd-model">
<summary>How the odds work</summary>
<div class="wyd-model-body">
<p><strong>Sourced numbers</strong> (see the <a href="learn-bat.html">Learn&nbsp;more page</a>
for full citations): adult bats fail to feed on ~7% of nights, young bats on up to a third of
theirs, and you start young — your hidden hunting skill is drawn around a 28% fail rate and
improves with every successful night, the way real juveniles learn. ~70 fasting hours is
fatal (≈3 nights of reserve). When your reserve hits zero, each roost-mate <em>who fed that
night</em> rescues you with P&nbsp;=&nbsp;0.02&nbsp;+&nbsp;0.60&nbsp;×&nbsp;bond — real
rescues track prior grooming and giving, not kinship. Donations are graded (a sip to a full
crop) and build bonds in proportion; grooming escalates into sharing; grooming also keeps
the mites off (below 0.5 hygiene they move in and drain −0.5&nbsp;🩸 a night). Bright
moonlight suppresses vampire bat foraging (Crespo et al. 1972) — on bright nights every
bat's odds worsen.</p>
<p><strong>Plausible, for play</strong> (invented for the game, flagged so you know):
the exact size of the moonlight penalty (+15%), storm and squall modifiers (+15–18% fail,
misses burn 1.5&nbsp;🩸), the learning rate (fail ×0.93 per success), bond decay
(−0.02/night), roost-mates' hidden personalities (big-hearted, tight-furred, far-ranger,
thin), and roost-mates rescuing each other through their own friendships. Roost-mates can
genuinely starve: a begging bat that no one feeds — including you — dies, and its
friendships die with it.</p>
<p>Score is a fitness ledger: nights survived, donations (scaled by size and need), lives
saved, grooming given, and your final bond portfolio. Death keeps the ledger you earned.
Balance targets and results are recorded in <code>sim/batsim2.py</code> (20,000-run Monte
Carlo per strategy).</p>
</div>
</details>

</div>
</section>
</div>

:::

<script>window.WYD_SPECIES = "bat";</script>
<script src="assets/js/wyd-core.js"></script>
<script>
/* ── vampire bat engine v2 ──
   One 15-night season: moon cycle + squalls modulate everyone's hunting, the last
   three nights are the wet-season storm finale. You start a juvenile and learn to
   hunt; roost-mates are mortal and have hidden personalities. Score = fitness ledger.
   Balance targets + Monte Carlo results: ../sim/batsim2.py (20k runs/strategy):
   loner 54% survive/median 306 · masher 689 · old two-friends line 632 ·
   sip-widely 825 · portfolio 792 (p90 994, max ~1460). Deaths concentrate in the
   finale; <2.5% of runs die before night 4. Cap 2000 untouched. */
const PARTNER_NAMES = ["Quinoa","Fig","Juniper","Mango","Sage","Pepper","Hazel","Clover"];
const STRANGER_NAMES = ["Basil","Rowan","Ivy","Cinder","Moss","Fern"];
const BAT = {
  nights:15, stormStart:13,
  playerFail:0.28, playerLo:0.14, playerHi:0.45, learnRate:0.93, learnFloor:0.08,
  adultFail:0.07, adultLo:0.02, adultHi:0.18,
  decay:0.02, refuseCost:0.15, refuseOweCost:0.30,
  rescueBase:0.02, rescueSlope:0.60, rescueCap:0.9,
  staminaPerNight:3,
  moonBright:0.15, moonDim:0.07, squallP:0.07, squallMod:0.18, stormMod:0.15, stormBurn:1.5,
  richP:0.08, richMod:-0.05, richBonus:0.25,
  farFail:0.08, farBonus:0.5, farFrom:3,
  partnerCap:2.0,
  hygieneDecay:0.10, hygieneStormDecay:0.20, infestBelow:0.5, parasiteDrain:0.5, cureAbove:0.5, groomBackHyg:0.15,
  groomQuick:{cost:1, gain:0.07, recip:0.25}, groomLong:{cost:2, gain:0.16, recip:0.5},
  dimReturns:0.45,
  shares:[ {key:"sip",  label:"a sip",       blood:0.15, gain:0.08, ptsStarv:12, ptsHun:6},
           {key:"meal", label:"a meal",      blood:0.30, gain:0.15, ptsStarv:22, ptsHun:11},
           {key:"gen",  label:"a full crop", blood:0.50, gain:0.25, ptsStarv:38, ptsHun:19} ],
  pts:{night:15, fed:8, rescued:15, groomQ:2, groomL:3, save:38,
       endSurvive:120, endBond:45, endRoost:90} };
const TRAITS = {
  generous:{tag:"big-hearted",  hint:"grooms you back before you've even finished", recipMult:1.3},
  stingy:  {tag:"tight-furred", hint:"takes your grooming and gives little back",   recipMult:0.6},
  wanderer:{tag:"far-ranger",   hint:"hunts the far valleys — comes home heavy or not at all", failMult:1.6, feast:1.5},
  frail:   {tag:"thin",         hint:"older and slower than the rest; misses more nights", failAdd:0.06},
  plain:   {tag:"",             hint:"", } };
const TRAIT_DECK = ["generous","generous","stingy","stingy","wanderer","frail","plain","plain"];
let G = null;

const drawSkill = (base, spread, lo, hi)=> Math.min(hi, Math.max(lo,
  base * Math.pow(2, (roll() - 0.5) * spread)));
const reduceMotion = ()=> matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;

function wydStart(){
  $("#wyd-play").style.display = "block";
  $("#wyd-log").innerHTML = "";
  const deck = TRAIT_DECK.slice();
  for(let i=deck.length-1; i>0; i--){ const j=Math.floor(roll()*(i+1)); [deck[i],deck[j]]=[deck[j],deck[i]]; }
  G = {v:2, night:0, score:0, energy:2.5, stamina:3, alive:true, fedTonight:false,
       cause:"", selected:null, lastAct:"", fx:null, far:false, cond:null,
       moonOff: roll()*BAT.nights, pFail: drawSkill(BAT.playerFail, 1.5, BAT.playerLo, BAT.playerHi),
       hygiene:0.7, parasites:false, successes:0, event:null, lastEvent:"", deaths:[],
       ledger:{don:0, saves:0, rescued:0, grooms:0},
       partners: PARTNER_NAMES.map((n,i)=>{
         const t = deck[i], td = TRAITS[t];
         let pf = drawSkill(BAT.adultFail, 2.0, BAT.adultLo, BAT.adultHi);
         if(td.failMult) pf = Math.min(0.30, pf*td.failMult);
         if(td.failAdd)  pf = Math.min(0.30, pf+td.failAdd);
         return {id:i, name:n, trait:t, seen:false, pFail:pf, trust:0.35,
                 energy:1.2+0.8*roll(), alive:true, fedYou:false, youSaved:false,
                 fed:false, hungry:false, starving:false, groomed:false, shared:false};
       })};
  const close = [];
  while(close.length<2){ const k = Math.floor(roll()*8); if(!close.includes(k)) close.push(k); }
  G.partners.forEach((p,i)=>{ p.trust = close.includes(i) ? 0.55+0.2*roll() : 0.12+0.26*roll(); });
  G.pp = [];
  for(let i=0;i<8;i++){ G.pp[i]=[];
    for(let j=0;j<8;j++){ G.pp[i][j] = j<i ? G.pp[j][i] : (i===j ? 0 : (roll()<0.35 ? 0.3+0.55*roll() : 0.1*roll())); } }
  const friends = close.map(k=>G.partners[k].name).join(" and ");
  log(`Dusk. You hang among 8 roost-mates. ${friends} are old friends; the rest barely know you.`);
  duskPhase();
}

function wydHud(){
  const h = $("#wyd-hud"); if(!h || !G) return;
  const cells = [0,1,2].map(k=>{
    const f = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, G.energy - k));
    return `<i><b style="transform:scaleX(${f})"></b></i>`;
  }).join("");
  const pips = [0,1,2].map(k=>`<i class="${k < G.stamina ? "on":""}"></i>`).join("");
  const hygPct = Math.round((G.hygiene||0)*100);
  const aliveN = G.partners.filter(p=>p.alive).length;
  h.innerHTML = `<div class="wyd-ghud">
    <div class="gstat"><span class="gl">Night ${G.cond ? G.cond.icon : ""}</span><span class="gv">${G.night}<span class="wyd-of">/${BAT.nights}</span></span></div>
    <div class="gstat"><span class="gl">Blood 🩸 ${G.energy.toFixed(1)}</span><div class="wyd-bloodbar">${cells}</div></div>
    <div class="gstat"><span class="gl">Stamina ⚡</span><div class="wyd-pips">${pips}</div></div>
    <div class="gstat"><span class="gl">${G.parasites ? "🕷 Mites!" : "Groomed"}</span><div class="wyd-bloodbar wyd-hyg${G.parasites?" bad":""}"><i><b style="transform:scaleX(${(G.hygiene||0).toFixed(2)})"></b></i></div><span style="font-size:.58rem; color:var(--g-dim)">${hygPct}%</span></div>
    <div class="gstat"><span class="gl">Roost</span><span class="gv">${aliveN}<span class="wyd-of">/8</span></span></div>
    <div class="gstat"><span class="gl">Score</span><span class="gv">${Math.round(G.score)}</span></div>
  </div>`;
}

/* ── conditions: moon cycle, squalls, storms, rich nights ── */
/* one full lunar cycle per season (compressed; the real cycle is 29.5 d): every run
   sees a comparable dose of bright nights, but at different, unpredictable times */
function moonMod(night){
  const b = 0.5*(1+Math.cos(2*Math.PI*((night+G.moonOff)/BAT.nights)));
  if(b >= 0.75) return {mod:BAT.moonBright, moon:"bright"};
  if(b >= 0.55) return {mod:BAT.moonDim, moon:"dim"};
  return {mod:0, moon:"dark"};
}
function rollConditions(night){
  const m = moonMod(night);
  if(night >= BAT.stormStart)
    return {mod:m.mod+BAT.stormMod, stormy:true, rich:false, moon:m.moon, icon:"⛈", key:"storm",
      head:"The wet season is here.",
      text:`Storm after storm now. Rain floods the pastures, the herds huddle, and <strong>every
        bat's hunting suffers</strong> — a miss on a night this cold burns −${BAT.stormBurn} 🩸.
        ${night===BAT.nights ? "One more night. Just one." : "The colony moves roosts when it ends. Hold on."}`};
  if(roll() < BAT.squallP)
    return {mod:m.mod+BAT.squallMod, stormy:true, rich:false, moon:m.moon, icon:"🌧", key:"squall",
      head:"A squall blows in from the coast.",
      text:`Rain lashes the cave mouth. Hunting through it is miserable work — <strong>every bat's
        odds are worse tonight</strong>, and a miss in this cold burns −${BAT.stormBurn} 🩸.`};
  if(m.mod===0 && roll() < BAT.richP)
    return {mod:BAT.richMod, stormy:false, rich:true, moon:m.moon, icon:"✨", key:"rich",
      head:"The herd has moved into the near valley.",
      text:`A black, kind night — and the cattle are practically under the cave. <strong>Easy
        pickings for everyone</strong>, and full crops for the lucky.`};
  if(m.moon==="bright")
    return {mod:m.mod, stormy:false, rich:false, moon:m.moon, icon:"🌕", key:"bright",
      head:"A bright moon silvers the pastures.",
      text:`Every bat in the roost hesitates at the cave mouth. Vampire bats hate hunting under
        a full moon — in this light, the cattle see you coming, and so does everything that
        eats bats. <strong>Everyone's odds are worse tonight.</strong>`};
  if(m.moon==="dim")
    return {mod:m.mod, stormy:false, rich:false, moon:m.moon, icon:"🌗", key:"dim",
      head:"A half-lit night.",
      text:`Moonlight comes and goes behind the clouds. Not ideal hunting light, but workable.`};
  return {mod:0, stormy:false, rich:false, moon:m.moon, icon:"🌑", key:"dark",
    head:"A black, kind night.",
    text:`No moon to speak of. The kind of dark a vampire bat is built for.`};
}

/* ── dusk: conditions + pasture choice ── */
function duskPhase(){
  G.night++;
  G.cond = rollConditions(G.night);
  G.far = false;
  // roost-mates hunt tonight (resolved now, revealed at dawn)
  G.partners.forEach(p=>{
    if(!p.alive) return;
    p.trust = Math.max(0.02, p.trust - BAT.decay);
    p.groomed = false; p.shared = false;
    const pf = Math.min(0.9, Math.max(0.01, p.pFail + G.cond.mod));
    p.fed = roll() > pf;
    const feast = (p.trait==="wanderer" && p.fed) ? TRAITS.wanderer.feast : 1.0;
    p.energy = p.fed ? Math.min(BAT.partnerCap, p.energy + feast)
                     : p.energy - (G.cond.stormy ? BAT.stormBurn : 1);
    p.hungry = !p.fed;
    p.starving = p.energy <= 0;
    if(p.trait==="wanderer" && p.fed && feast>1 && !p.seen){ p.seen = true;
      log(`${p.name} comes home heavy with blood — a far-ranger.`); }
  });
  const grief = G.deaths.length && G.deathsFresh
    ? `<p class="wyd-story wyd-grief">The roost is quieter. <strong>${esc(G.deathsFresh)}</strong> didn't
       wake at dusk — starved, huddled at the edge of the colony. No one had enough to give.</p>` : "";
  G.deathsFresh = "";
  const stormNear = G.night===BAT.stormStart-2 ? `<p class="wyd-story"><strong>You can smell rain
    on the wind.</strong> The storms are two nights away. Whatever bonds you mean to build,
    build them now.</p>` : "";
  const canFar = G.night >= BAT.farFrom;
  const choices = canFar
    ? `<button class="btnx wyd-huntopt" id="wyd-hunt-near">Hunt the near pastures <span class="sub">the usual odds</span></button>
       <button class="btnx wyd-huntopt" id="wyd-hunt-far">Push to the far valley <span class="sub">riskier (+${Math.round(BAT.farFail*100)}% fail) · richer (+${BAT.farBonus} 🩸)</span></button>`
    : `<button class="btnx btnx--solid" id="wyd-hunt-near">Follow the colony out <span class="sub">${G.night===1 ? "stay close; you're still learning":"the near pastures"}</span></button>`;
  scene(`<div class="wyd-round">${G.cond.icon} Night ${G.night} of ${BAT.nights} · dusk</div>
    <h3>${G.cond.head}</h3>
    <p class="wyd-story">${G.cond.text}</p>
    ${grief}${stormNear}
    <div class="wyd-choices">${choices}</div>`, "night");
  $("#wyd-hunt-near").onclick = ()=>{ G.far=false; flightScene(resolveNight); };
  const farBtn = $("#wyd-hunt-far");
  if(farBtn) farBtn.onclick = ()=>{ G.far=true; flightScene(resolveNight); };
}

/* ── the hunt (flight scene): full cinematic night 1, compressed after ── */
function flightScene(cb){
  const pf = Math.min(0.95, Math.max(0.02, G.pFail + G.cond.mod + (G.far ? BAT.farFail : 0)));
  G.fedTonight = roll() > pf;
  if(reduceMotion()){ cb(); return; }
  const first = G.night === 1;
  const condCls = G.cond.stormy ? " f-storm" : G.cond.moon==="bright" ? " f-moonbright" : "";
  const moonEm = G.cond.stormy ? "🌧" : G.cond.moon==="bright" ? "🌕" : G.cond.moon==="dim" ? "🌗" : "🌘";
  scene(`<div class="wyd-round">${G.cond.icon} Night ${G.night} of ${BAT.nights} · the hunt</div>
    <div class="wyd-flight${condCls}"><span class="fmoon">${moonEm}</span>
      <span class="fcave" aria-hidden="true"></span>
      <span class="frain" aria-hidden="true"></span>
      <span class="fbat"><span class="fbatin">🦇</span></span>
      <span class="fcow">🐄</span>
      <span class="fsus">💤</span>
      <span class="fdrip d1">🩸</span><span class="fdrip d2">🩸</span><span class="fdrip d3">🩸</span>
      <div class="fground"></div></div>
    <p class="wyd-story" id="wyd-flightstory">${
      G.far ? "You skip the near pastures and beat upwind toward the far valley, where the herds are fat and unbothered…"
      : G.cond.stormy ? "You push out into the rain with the colony, wings heavy before you've cleared the cave…"
      : "You pour out of the cave with the colony and ride the dark toward the pastures. Somewhere below, a herd is sleeping…"}</p>
    <div class="wyd-choices"><button class="btnx" id="wyd-skip">Skip →</button></div>`, "night");
  const box = document.querySelector("#wyd-scene .wyd-flight");
  const story = $("#wyd-flightstory");
  let done = false;
  const timers = [];
  const go = ()=>{ if(done) return; done = true; timers.forEach(clearTimeout); cb(); };
  const at = (ms, fn)=>timers.push(setTimeout(fn, ms));
  $("#wyd-skip").onclick = go;
  const T = first ? [60, 5000, 10000, 15000, 17800, 20500] : [50, 2400, 4600, 6600, 7600, 8600];
  at(T[0], ()=>box.classList.add("f-out"));
  at(T[1], ()=>{
    box.classList.add("f-sus");
    story.innerHTML = G.cond.stormy
      ? "You find the herd hunched against the rain, drop through a gust onto a cow's back, and cling on to make the cut…"
      : G.cond.moon==="bright"
      ? "Too bright. You circle twice, waiting on a cloud, then drop to the cow's back and make the cut…"
      : "You slow, circle once, and settle onto the cow's back. It sleeps on. You pick your spot and make the cut…";
  });
  at(T[2], ()=>{
    box.classList.add("f-reveal", G.fedTonight ? "f-fed" : "f-fail");
    story.innerHTML = G.fedTonight
      ? "<strong>You latch on and drink.</strong> The cow never wakes. Twenty quiet minutes, and you're heavy with blood."
      : "<strong>The cow jolts awake and kicks.</strong> A hoof catches you, and you tumble into the grass. No meal tonight.";
  });
  at(T[3], ()=>{
    box.classList.remove("f-out");
    box.classList.add("f-home");
    story.innerHTML = G.fedTonight
      ? "You lift off heavy and slow, turn for home, and fold into the dark of the cave among the warm bodies."
      : "You shake off the grass and fly home empty, tucking into the dark of the cave among the warm bodies.";
  });
  at(T[4], ()=>box.classList.add("f-rest"));
  at(T[5], go);
}

/* ── resolve the night: blood, learning, mites, rescue ── */
function resolveNight(){
  const burn = G.cond.stormy ? BAT.stormBurn : 1;
  let paraNote = "";
  G.hygiene = Math.max(0, G.hygiene - (G.cond.stormy ? BAT.hygieneStormDecay : BAT.hygieneDecay));
  if(G.fedTonight){
    G.successes++;
    const learned = G.pFail > BAT.learnFloor + 0.001;
    G.pFail = Math.max(BAT.learnFloor, G.pFail * BAT.learnRate);
    G.energy = Math.min(3, G.energy + 1 + (G.far ? BAT.farBonus : 0) + (G.cond.rich ? BAT.richBonus : 0));
    G.score += BAT.pts.fed;
    if(G.parasites){ G.energy = Math.max(0, G.energy - BAT.parasiteDrain);
      paraNote = ` The <strong>mites</strong> cost you an extra −${BAT.parasiteDrain} 🩸 tonight.`; }
    else paraNote = miteCheck();
    const learnNote = learned && (G.successes===3 || G.successes===7)
      ? ` <em>The cuts come easier now — you're getting good at this.</em>` : "";
    const beg = G.partners.filter(p=>p.alive && p.hungry);
    const starv = beg.filter(p=>p.starving);
    log(`Night ${G.night}: fed${G.far?" (far valley)":""}. +${BAT.pts.fed}.`, "good");
    showNightSummary("A good night.",
      `You found a host and fed for twenty minutes${G.far ? " — and the far valley paid: a full, heavy crop":""}.${
        G.night===1 ? ` (Adult bats strike out on about ${fmtP(BAT.adultFail)} of nights; young bats
        like you, far more often. Tonight the luck held.)` : ""}${learnNote}
       ${starv.length ? `<strong>${starv.length===1 ? esc(starv[0].name)+" is starving" : starv.length+" roost-mates are starving"}</strong> — a bat with an empty reserve doesn't see a second dawn unless someone feeds it.`
        : beg.length ? `<strong>${beg.length} roost-mate${beg.length>1?"s":""} came home empty</strong>. Back at the roost, you could share.`
        : "Everyone else fed too, so no one is begging tonight."}${paraNote}`);
    return;
  }
  G.energy -= burn;
  G.hygiene = Math.max(0, G.hygiene - 0.05);   // tumbled in the grass
  if(G.parasites) G.energy = Math.max(-0.1, G.energy - BAT.parasiteDrain);
  else paraNote = miteCheck();
  log(`Night ${G.night}: failed to feed${G.cond.stormy ? " (storm, −"+burn+" 🩸)":""}.`, "bad");
  if(G.energy > 0){
    G.score += BAT.pts.night - 10;  // small consolation tick; the +night comes at dawn
    showNightSummary("You struck out.",
      `${G.cond.stormy ? "A miserable, rain-blind hunt, and a cow that wouldn't settle." :
        G.cond.moon==="bright" ? "Too much light. The cow saw you drop and was on its feet before you landed." :
        "A restless cow, a kick you didn't dodge, no meal tonight."}${G.night===1
        ? ` (Adults strike out on about ${fmtP(BAT.adultFail)} of nights; young bats like you, far more often.)` : ""}
       Reserve: <strong>${Math.max(0,G.energy).toFixed(1)} night${G.energy===1?"":"s"}</strong>. You can't share tonight,
       but you can still groom.${paraNote} ${G.energy<=1 ? "<strong>One more bad night and you'll be begging for your life.</strong>":""}`);
    return;
  }
  begResolution();
}
function miteCheck(){
  if(!G.parasites && G.hygiene < BAT.infestBelow && roll() < (BAT.infestBelow - G.hygiene)){
    G.parasites = true;
    log(`Night ${G.night}: infested with mites (hygiene ${G.hygiene.toFixed(2)}).`, "bad");
    return ` No one has groomed you in too long: <strong>bat mites have moved in</strong>.
      They'll drain −${BAT.parasiteDrain} 🩸 every night until roost-mates groom them off you.`;
  }
  return "";
}

function showNightSummary(head, story){
  scene(`<div class="wyd-round">${G.cond.icon} Night ${G.night} of ${BAT.nights} · foraging</div>
    <h3>${head}</h3>
    <p class="wyd-story">${story}</p>
    <div class="wyd-choices"><button class="btnx btnx--solid" id="wyd-next">Fly home at dawn →</button></div>`, "night");
  $("#wyd-next").onclick = roostPhase;
}

function begResolution(){
  const helpers = G.partners.filter(p=>p.alive && p.fed)
    .map(p=>({p, pr: Math.min(BAT.rescueCap, BAT.rescueBase + BAT.rescueSlope*p.trust)}));
  const pAny = 1 - helpers.reduce((a,h)=>a*(1-h.pr), 1);
  const savior = helpers.find(h=>roll() < h.pr);
  if(savior){
    savior.p.fedYou = true; savior.p.trust = Math.min(1, savior.p.trust + 0.1);
    G.energy = 1; G.score += BAT.pts.rescued; G.ledger.rescued++;
    log(`Night ${G.night}: rescued by ${savior.p.name}.`, "good");
    scene(`<div class="wyd-round">${G.cond.icon} Night ${G.night} of ${BAT.nights} · no meal, reserve empty</div>
      <h3>Saved.</h3>`+ outcomeBlock(
      `Given your bonds, the chance that a roost-mate who fed tonight would save you was <strong>${fmtP(pAny)}</strong>, and ${esc(savior.p.name)} came through.`,
      `You beg, licking at roost-mates' mouths. <strong>${esc(savior.p.name)}</strong> regurgitates part of
       tonight's meal to you. You'll see another dawn, and you owe them.`,
      "In real life",
      `Rescue isn't charity: bats with stronger giving and grooming histories have more donors when
       their luck fails. Your investment just paid out.`,
      "Wilkinson 1984 · Carter & Wilkinson 2013"), "night");
    $("#wyd-next").onclick = roostPhase;
    return;
  }
  G.alive = false; G.cause = "starved";
  log(`Night ${G.night}: starved. ☠`, "bad");
  scene(`<div class="wyd-round">${G.cond.icon} Night ${G.night} of ${BAT.nights} · no meal, reserve empty</div>
    <h3>No one came.</h3>`+ outcomeBlock(
    `Given your bonds, the chance that a roost-mate who fed tonight would save you was <strong>${fmtP(pAny)}</strong>. No one did.`,
    `You fasted past ~70 hours. In the morning the roost is one bat smaller.`,
    "In real life",
    `Starvation is the vampire bat's constant threat, and weak social bonds are the risk factor.
     Bats that invest in partners survive their unlucky streaks; loners often don't.`,
    "Wilkinson 1984 Nature"), "night");
  $("#wyd-next").onclick = batEnd;
}

/* ── dawn events ── */
function rollDawnEvent(){
  G.event = null;
  const alive = G.partners.filter(p=>p.alive);
  // a stranger claims an empty spot (takes priority over random events)
  const deadSlot = G.partners.find(p=>!p.alive && !p.replaced);
  const graceOver = G.night > (G.lastDeathNight||0) + 1;   // let a death breathe for a night
  if(deadSlot && graceOver && STRANGER_NAMES.length && roll() < 0.5){
    const name = STRANGER_NAMES.shift();
    deadSlot.replaced = true;
    const t = ["generous","stingy","wanderer","frail","plain","plain"][Math.floor(roll()*6)];
    const td = TRAITS[t];
    let pf = drawSkill(BAT.adultFail, 2.0, BAT.adultLo, BAT.adultHi);
    if(td.failMult) pf = Math.min(0.30, pf*td.failMult);
    if(td.failAdd)  pf = Math.min(0.30, pf+td.failAdd);
    const s = {id:deadSlot.id, name, trait:t, seen:false, pFail:pf, trust:0.08+0.12*roll(),
               energy:1.5, alive:true, fedYou:false, youSaved:false,
               fed:true, hungry:false, starving:false, groomed:false, shared:false, stranger:true};
    G.partners[deadSlot.id] = s;
    for(let j=0;j<8;j++){ if(j!==s.id){ G.pp[s.id][j] = G.pp[j][s.id] = 0.05+0.15*roll(); } }
    G.event = {type:"stranger", id:s.id,
      text:`A <strong>stranger</strong> has taken the empty spot where ${esc(deadSlot.name)} used to hang —
        a wiry newcomer the others call <strong>${esc(name)}</strong>. New bonds start small:
        real bats "test the waters" with grooming before they ever share blood.`};
    log(`Dawn: ${name} joins the roost.`);
    return;
  }
  if(roll() > 0.3 || alive.length < 3) return;
  const pool = ["squabble","pup","coldsnap"].filter(t=>t!==G.lastEvent);
  const type = pool[Math.floor(roll()*pool.length)];
  G.lastEvent = type;
  if(type==="squabble"){
    const pairs = [];
    for(const a of alive) for(const b of alive) if(a.id<b.id && G.pp[a.id][b.id]>0.3) pairs.push([a,b]);
    if(!pairs.length) return;
    const [a,b] = pairs[Math.floor(roll()*pairs.length)];
    G.pp[a.id][b.id] = G.pp[b.id][a.id] = Math.max(0.02, G.pp[a.id][b.id]-0.25);
    G.event = {type:"squabble", ids:[a.id,b.id],
      text:`<strong>${esc(a.name)} and ${esc(b.name)} squabbled</strong> over a roosting spot at dawn —
        their friendship just took a hit, and both are ruffled and lonely.
        Grooming either of them this dawn builds <strong>+50% extra bond</strong>.`};
  } else if(type==="pup"){
    const p = alive[Math.floor(roll()*alive.length)];
    G.event = {type:"pup", id:p.id,
      text:`<strong>${esc(p.name)}'s pup</strong> clings to her, thin. She's been giving it everything
        she has. Anything you give <em>her</em> this dawn — grooming or blood — counts
        <strong>double</strong> toward your bond.`};
  } else {
    G.event = {type:"coldsnap",
      text:`A <strong>cold dawn</strong>; the roost huddles close. Bodies pressed together make long
        grooming easy: it costs only <strong>1 ⚡</strong> this dawn.`};
  }
}

/* ── the roost (dawn) ── */
function roostPhase(){
  G.stamina = G.energy <= 1 ? BAT.staminaPerNight - 1 : BAT.staminaPerNight;
  G.selected = null; G.fx = null; G.lastAct = "";
  rollDawnEvent();
  wydSaveRun(G);  // autosave at every dawn; Exit + Resume pick up from here
  renderRoost();
}
function wydResumeRun(g){
  if(!g || g.v !== 2){ wydClearRun(); wydStart(); return; }
  G = g; G.selected = null; G.lastAct = ""; G.fx = null;
  $("#wyd-play").style.display = "block";
  $("#wyd-log").innerHTML = "";
  log(`Resumed at dawn after night ${G.night}.`);
  renderRoost();
}
function eventMult(p, isShare){
  if(!G.event) return 1;
  if(G.event.type==="squabble" && !isShare && G.event.ids.includes(p.id)) return 1.5;
  if(G.event.type==="pup" && G.event.id===p.id) return 2;
  return 1;
}
function netSvg(){
  const cx=200, cy=155, rx=150, ry=105;
  const pos = G.partners.map((p,i)=>{
    const a = -Math.PI/2 + i*(2*Math.PI/8);
    return {x: cx + rx*Math.cos(a), y: cy + ry*Math.sin(a)};
  });
  let pp="", edges="", nodes="";
  for(let i=0;i<8;i++) for(let j=i+1;j<8;j++){
    if(!G.partners[i].alive || !G.partners[j].alive) continue;
    const b = G.pp[i][j];
    if(b > 0.28) pp += `<line x1="${pos[i].x.toFixed(0)}" y1="${pos[i].y.toFixed(0)}"
      x2="${pos[j].x.toFixed(0)}" y2="${pos[j].y.toFixed(0)}" stroke="currentColor"
      stroke-width="${(0.4 + b*2.2).toFixed(1)}" opacity="${(0.08 + b*0.16).toFixed(2)}"/>`;
  }
  G.partners.forEach((p,i)=>{
    const {x,y} = pos[i];
    if(!p.alive){
      nodes += `<g class="node gone" aria-hidden="true">
        <circle cx="${x.toFixed(0)}" cy="${y.toFixed(0)}" r="15"/>
        <text x="${x.toFixed(0)}" y="${(y+29).toFixed(0)}">${esc(p.name)}</text></g>`;
      return;
    }
    edges += `<line class="edge" x1="${cx}" y1="${cy}" x2="${x.toFixed(0)}" y2="${y.toFixed(0)}"
      stroke-width="${(0.6 + p.trust*6).toFixed(1)}" opacity="${(0.2 + p.trust*0.65).toFixed(2)}"/>`;
    const begState = p.starving && !p.shared ? "starving" : (p.hungry && !p.shared ? "hungry" : "");
    const cls = "node" + (begState==="starving" ? " starving" : begState==="hungry" ? " hungry":"") + (G.selected===p.id ? " sel":"");
    nodes += `<g class="${cls}" data-pid="${p.id}" tabindex="0" role="button"
      aria-label="${esc(p.name)}, bond ${p.trust.toFixed(2)}${begState ? ", "+begState : ""}">
      <circle cx="${x.toFixed(0)}" cy="${y.toFixed(0)}" r="28" style="fill:transparent; stroke:none; animation:none; cursor:pointer"/>
      ${G.selected===p.id ? `<circle class="selring" cx="${x.toFixed(0)}" cy="${y.toFixed(0)}" r="22"/>` : ""}
      <circle cx="${x.toFixed(0)}" cy="${y.toFixed(0)}" r="15"/>
      <text x="${x.toFixed(0)}" y="${(y+29).toFixed(0)}">${esc(p.name)}${p.fedYou?" ♥":""}${p.youSaved?" ✚":""}</text>
      ${begState==="starving" ? `<text class="beg starv" x="${x.toFixed(0)}" y="${(y-22).toFixed(0)}">STARVING</text>`
        : begState==="hungry" ? `<text class="beg" x="${x.toFixed(0)}" y="${(y-22).toFixed(0)}">BEGGING</text>`:""}
    </g>`;
  });
  return `<svg class="wyd-net" viewBox="0 0 400 310" role="img"
    aria-label="The colony's social network: you at the center, roost-mates around you; line thickness shows your bond, faint lines are their own friendships. Starving bats will die without blood.">
    ${pp}${edges}
    <g class="node you"><circle cx="${cx}" cy="${cy}" r="17"/><text x="${cx}" y="${cy+4}">YOU</text></g>
    ${nodes}</svg>`;
}
function traitLine(p){
  if(!p.seen || !TRAITS[p.trait].tag) return "";
  return `<span class="wyd-ptag wyd-ptrait">${TRAITS[p.trait].tag}</span>`;
}
function reciprocate(p, pr){
  const td = TRAITS[p.trait];
  if(td.recipMult) pr *= td.recipMult;
  if(roll() < Math.min(0.95, pr)){
    G.hygiene = Math.min(1, G.hygiene + BAT.groomBackHyg);
    emitStream(p.id, {color:"var(--g-warm)", r:3, count:6, interval:240, travel:1400,
      reverse:true, delay:1200});
    if(!p.seen && (p.trait==="generous")){ p.seen = true; }
    let cured = "";
    if(G.parasites && G.hygiene >= BAT.cureAbove){
      G.parasites = false; cured = " The mites are gone.";
      log(`Night ${G.night}: ${p.name} groomed the mites off you.`, "good");
    } else {
      log(`Night ${G.night}: ${p.name} grooms you back (hygiene ${G.hygiene.toFixed(2)}).`, "good");
    }
    const flavor = p.trait==="generous" ? ` ${TRAITS.generous.hint.charAt(0).toUpperCase()+TRAITS.generous.hint.slice(1)}.` : "";
    return ` <strong>${esc(p.name)} grooms you back.</strong>${cured}${flavor}`;
  }
  if(!p.seen && p.trait==="stingy" && roll()<0.6){ p.seen = true;
    return ` ${esc(p.name)} ${TRAITS.stingy.hint}.`; }
  return "";
}
function partnerPanel(){
  if(G.selected===null){
    const starv = G.partners.filter(p=>p.alive && p.starving && !p.shared);
    return `<div class="wyd-partner"><h4>Pick a roost-mate</h4>
      <p class="wyd-story" style="font-size:.9rem">Tap a bat. Green lines are <strong>your</strong> bonds:
      the bats most likely to save you when a night goes wrong. Faint lines are their friendships
      with each other. Bonds fade −${BAT.decay.toFixed(2)} every night; grooming keeps them warm, and
      groomed bats groom you back.${starv.length ? ` <strong class="wyd-warnink">A starving bat dies at
      dusk unless somebody — maybe you — feeds it.</strong>`:""}</p>
      ${G.lastAct ? `<p class="wyd-feedback">${G.lastAct}</p>`:""}</div>`;
  }
  const p = G.partners[G.selected];
  const longCost = (G.event && G.event.type==="coldsnap") ? 1 : BAT.groomLong.cost;
  const canQ = G.stamina>=BAT.groomQuick.cost && !p.groomed;
  const canL = G.stamina>=longCost && !p.groomed;
  const canShareBase = G.stamina>=1 && G.fedTonight && p.hungry && !p.shared;
  const shareWhy = !G.fedTonight ? "you didn't feed tonight"
    : !p.hungry || p.shared ? "not hungry"
    : G.stamina<1 ? "no stamina left" : "reserve too low";
  const em = eventMult(p, true), gm = eventMult(p, false);
  const shareBtns = BAT.shares.map(s=>{
    const ok = canShareBase && G.energy > s.blood + 0.4;
    return `<button class="btnx ${s.key==="meal"?"btnx--solid":""} ${p.starving?"wyd-savebtn":""}" data-share="${s.key}" ${ok?"":"disabled"}>
      ${p.starving ? "Save her: share" : "Share"} ${s.label} · 1 ⚡ −${s.blood} 🩸 <span class="sub">${ok? "bond +"+(s.gain*em).toFixed(2) : shareWhy}</span></button>`;
  }).join("");
  return `<div class="wyd-partner">
    <h4>${esc(p.name)}</h4>
    <div class="gl">Bond ${p.trust.toFixed(2)}</div>
    <div class="wyd-bondbar"><b style="width:${(p.trust*100).toFixed(0)}%"></b></div>
    <div class="wyd-ptags">
      ${p.shared ? "" : p.starving ? `<span class="wyd-ptag hot">☠ starving — dies at dusk unfed</span>`
        : p.hungry ? `<span class="wyd-ptag hot">begging (didn't feed)</span>` : `<span class="wyd-ptag">fed tonight</span>`}
      ${p.fedYou ? `<span class="wyd-ptag hot">♥ once saved your life</span>`:""}
      ${p.youSaved ? `<span class="wyd-ptag good">✚ you saved their life</span>`:""}
      ${traitLine(p)}
      ${p.groomed ? `<span class="wyd-ptag">groomed tonight</span>`:""}
      ${p.shared ? `<span class="wyd-ptag">shared with tonight</span>`:""}
    </div>
    <div class="wyd-pacts">
      <button class="btnx" id="wyd-groom-q" ${canQ?"":"disabled"}>Quick groom · ${BAT.groomQuick.cost} ⚡ <span class="sub">bond +${(BAT.groomQuick.gain*gm*(1-BAT.dimReturns*p.trust)).toFixed(2)} · they may groom back</span></button>
      <button class="btnx" id="wyd-groom-l" ${canL?"":"disabled"}>Long groom · ${longCost} ⚡ <span class="sub">bond +${(BAT.groomLong.gain*gm*(1-BAT.dimReturns*p.trust)).toFixed(2)} · likely groomed back</span></button>
      ${shareBtns}
    </div>
    ${G.lastAct ? `<p class="wyd-feedback">${G.lastAct}</p>`:""}
  </div>`;
}
function renderRoost(){
  const owed = G.partners.filter(p=>p.alive && p.hungry && !p.shared);
  const starving = owed.filter(p=>p.starving);
  const warn = starving.length
    ? `<strong>${starving.map(p=>esc(p.name)).join(" and ")} ${starving.length>1?"are":"is"} starving.</strong>
       A starving bat that no one feeds dies at dusk.${G.fedTonight ? " You fed tonight — you could be the one.":" You have no blood to give, but their other friends might."}`
    : G.fedTonight && owed.length
    ? `${owed.length} begging bat${owed.length>1?"s":""} will remember being refused (bond −${BAT.refuseCost.toFixed(2)}${owed.some(p=>p.fedYou)? ", −"+BAT.refuseOweCost.toFixed(2)+" for past donors":""}).`
    : "";
  const hyg = G.parasites ? `<strong>🕷 Mites!</strong> Get groomed to clear them.`
    : G.hygiene < BAT.infestBelow ? `Your fur needs grooming (hygiene ${G.hygiene.toFixed(2)}); mite risk is climbing.` : "";
  const eventBanner = G.event ? `<p class="wyd-story wyd-event">${G.event.text}</p>` : "";
  scene(`<div class="wyd-round">🌅 Dawn after night ${G.night} of ${BAT.nights} · the roost</div>
    <h3>Who do you invest in?</h3>
    <p class="wyd-story">You have <strong>${G.stamina} ⚡ stamina</strong> before sleep${
      G.energy <= 1 ? " (hunger has left you weak)" : ""}.
    Groom to build bonds${G.fedTonight? "; share blood to feed a begging bat (you choose how much)":" (no sharing tonight; you didn't feed)"}. ${hyg}</p>
    ${eventBanner}
    <div class="wyd-roost">
      <div>${netSvg()}</div>
      <div>${partnerPanel()}
        <div class="wyd-sleeprow"><button class="btnx wyd-clay" id="wyd-sleep">Sleep until dusk →</button>
        <div class="wyd-sleepwarn">${warn}</div></div>
      </div>
    </div>`, "day");
  $$("#wyd-scene .node[data-pid]").forEach(n=>{
    const pick = ()=>{ G.selected = +n.dataset.pid; G.lastAct = ""; renderRoost(); };
    n.addEventListener("click", pick);
    n.addEventListener("keydown", e=>{ if(e.key==="Enter"||e.key===" "){ e.preventDefault(); pick(); } });
  });
  const p = G.selected!==null ? G.partners[G.selected] : null;
  const gq = $("#wyd-groom-q"), gl = $("#wyd-groom-l");
  const longCost = (G.event && G.event.type==="coldsnap") ? 1 : BAT.groomLong.cost;
  if(gq) gq.onclick = ()=>{
    G.stamina -= BAT.groomQuick.cost; p.groomed = true;
    const gain = BAT.groomQuick.gain * eventMult(p,false) * (1-BAT.dimReturns*p.trust);
    p.trust = Math.min(1, p.trust + gain); G.score += BAT.pts.groomQ; G.ledger.grooms++;
    if(!p.seen && p.trait==="plain") p.seen = true;
    log(`Night ${G.night}: quick-groomed ${p.name}. Bond ${p.trust.toFixed(2)}. +${BAT.pts.groomQ}.`, "good");
    G.lastAct = `You work through ${esc(p.name)}'s fur.` + reciprocate(p, BAT.groomQuick.recip + 0.55*p.trust);
    G.fx = {pid: p.id, kind:"groom", n:1};
    renderRoost();
  };
  if(gl) gl.onclick = ()=>{
    G.stamina -= longCost; p.groomed = true;
    const gain = BAT.groomLong.gain * eventMult(p,false) * (1-BAT.dimReturns*p.trust);
    p.trust = Math.min(1, p.trust + gain); G.score += BAT.pts.groomL; G.ledger.grooms++;
    if(!p.seen && p.trait==="plain") p.seen = true;
    log(`Night ${G.night}: long-groomed ${p.name}. Bond ${p.trust.toFixed(2)}. +${BAT.pts.groomL}.`, "good");
    G.lastAct = `A long, thorough grooming session with ${esc(p.name)}.` + reciprocate(p, BAT.groomLong.recip + 0.5*p.trust);
    G.fx = {pid: p.id, kind:"groom", n:2};
    renderRoost();
  };
  $$("#wyd-scene [data-share]").forEach(b=>b.onclick = ()=>{
    const s = BAT.shares.find(x=>x.key===b.dataset.share);
    const wasStarving = p.starving;
    G.stamina--; p.shared = true; p.hungry = false;
    G.energy = Math.max(0.3, G.energy - s.blood);
    const gain = s.gain * eventMult(p,true);
    p.trust = Math.min(1, p.trust + gain);
    G.ledger.don++;
    if(wasStarving){
      p.starving = false; p.energy = 1; p.youSaved = true;
      G.score += BAT.pts.save + s.ptsStarv; G.ledger.saves++;
      log(`Night ${G.night}: SAVED ${p.name} from starving (${s.label}). +${BAT.pts.save + s.ptsStarv}.`, "good");
      G.lastAct = `${esc(p.name)} feeds desperately from your mouth — ${s.label}, −${s.blood} 🩸.
        <strong>You just saved a life.</strong> Bats remember that above all else.`;
    } else {
      p.energy = Math.min(BAT.partnerCap, p.energy + 0.5);
      G.score += s.ptsHun;
      log(`Night ${G.night}: shared ${s.label} with ${p.name}. Bond ${p.trust.toFixed(2)}. +${s.ptsHun}.`, "good");
      G.lastAct = `${esc(p.name)} feeds from your mouth: ${s.label}, −${s.blood} 🩸. Bats remember generosity in proportion.`;
    }
    G.fx = {pid: p.id, kind:"share", n: s.key==="sip" ? 1 : s.key==="meal" ? 2 : 3};
    renderRoost();
  });
  $("#wyd-sleep").onclick = sleep;
  if(G.fx){ runFx(G.fx); G.fx = null; }
}
/* particle streams along a network edge (unchanged from v1) */
function emitStream(pid, o){
  const cx=200, cy=155, rx=150, ry=105;
  const a = -Math.PI/2 + pid*(2*Math.PI/8);
  const px = cx + rx*Math.cos(a), py = cy + ry*Math.sin(a);
  const sx = o.reverse ? px : cx, sy = o.reverse ? py : cy;
  const dx = o.reverse ? cx-px : px-cx, dy = o.reverse ? cy-py : py-cy;
  const travel = o.travel || 1300;
  let emitted = 0;
  const start = ()=>{
    const iv = setInterval(()=>{
      const svg = document.querySelector("#wyd-scene .wyd-net");
      if(!svg || emitted >= o.count){ clearInterval(iv); return; }
      emitted++;
      const c = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg","circle");
      c.setAttribute("cx",sx); c.setAttribute("cy",sy); c.setAttribute("r",o.r);
      c.setAttribute("fill",o.color); c.classList.add("wyd-fxdot");
      c.style.transition = `transform ${travel}ms cubic-bezier(.25,.6,.35,1), opacity ${travel+150}ms ease`;
      svg.appendChild(c);
      requestAnimationFrame(()=>requestAnimationFrame(()=>{
        c.style.transform = `translate(${dx}px, ${dy}px)`;
        c.style.opacity = "0.12";
      }));
      setTimeout(()=>c.remove(), travel + 250);
    }, o.interval);
  };
  o.delay ? setTimeout(start, o.delay) : start();
}
function runFx(fx){
  if(fx.kind === "groom"){
    emitStream(fx.pid, {color:"var(--g-warm)", r:3.5,
      count: fx.n===1 ? 13 : 26, interval:230, travel:1400});
  } else {
    emitStream(fx.pid, {color:"var(--g-accent)", r:3.5 + fx.n,
      count: fx.n, interval:200, travel:1000});
  }
}

/* ── sleep: refusals, background rescue, partner deaths, season end ── */
function sleep(){
  if(G.fedTonight){
    G.partners.filter(p=>p.alive && p.hungry && !p.shared).forEach(p=>{
      p.trust = Math.max(0.02, p.trust - (p.fedYou ? BAT.refuseOweCost : BAT.refuseCost));
      log(`Night ${G.night}: refused ${p.name}. Bond ${p.trust.toFixed(2)}.`, "bad");
    });
  }
  // starving bats you didn't feed: their own friends may save them — or not
  const lost = [];
  G.partners.forEach(p=>{
    if(!p.alive || !p.starving || p.shared) return;
    let rescued = false;
    for(const q of G.partners){
      if(q.id===p.id || !q.alive || !q.fed) continue;
      if(roll() < Math.min(BAT.rescueCap, BAT.rescueBase + BAT.rescueSlope*G.pp[p.id][q.id])){
        rescued = true;
        log(`Night ${G.night}: ${q.name} fed ${p.name} — a near thing.`, "good");
        break;
      }
    }
    if(rescued){ p.energy = 1; p.starving = false; }
    else {
      p.alive = false; lost.push(p.name);
      G.deaths.push(p.name); G.lastDeathNight = G.night;
      log(`Night ${G.night}: ${p.name} starved to death. ☠`, "bad");
    }
  });
  if(lost.length) G.deathsFresh = lost.join(" and ");
  G.lastAct = ""; G.event = null;
  G.score += BAT.pts.night;
  if(G.night >= BAT.nights){ G.cause = "season"; batEnd(); return; }
  duskPhase();
}

/* ── end of the run ── */
function batEnd(){
  let score = Math.round(G.score), verdict;
  const alive = G.partners.filter(p=>p.alive);
  const bonds = alive.reduce((a,p)=>a+p.trust,0);
  const saved = G.partners.filter(p=>p.youSaved).map(p=>p.name);
  const saviors = G.partners.filter(p=>p.fedYou).map(p=>p.name);
  if(G.alive){
    score += BAT.pts.endSurvive + Math.round(bonds*BAT.pts.endBond)
           + (alive.length===8 ? BAT.pts.endRoost : 0);
    const bits = [];
    if(saved.length) bits.push(`you pulled ${saved.join(" and ")} back from the edge of starvation`);
    if(saviors.length) bits.push(`${saviors.join(" and ")} once kept you alive`);
    bits.push(alive.length===8
      ? "every single bat made it through — a whole-roost bonus few runs ever see"
      : G.deaths.length ? `the roost lost ${G.deaths.join(" and ")} along the way` : "");
    verdict = `You survived all ${BAT.nights} nights, and as the wet season begins you move roosts
      with the colony. Along the way ${bits.filter(Boolean).join("; ")}. Final average bond
      ${(bonds/Math.max(1,alive.length)).toFixed(2)}. Real vampire bats survive the same way —
      not by luck, but by portfolio.`;
  } else {
    verdict = `You starved on night ${G.night}${G.cond && G.cond.stormy ? ", with the storms overhead" : ""}.
      ${saved.length ? `You saved ${saved.join(" and ")} before the end — the ledger keeps what you gave. ` : ""}Real
      bats die exactly this way, usually the ones without strong giving and grooming histories.
      Next run, invest earlier: bonds are the only insurance a vampire bat gets, and the storms
      always come.`;
  }
  wydEnd({score, verdict, nights: G.night});
}
</script>
